edition.title: সমাপ্তি
edition.description: কলকাতা-পড়ুয়া অপূর্ব বিয়ে করে গ্রামের দুরন্ত মেয়ে মৃন্ময়ীকে, যে তখনও বউ হতে শেখেনি।

provenance.source_edition: Katha-Chatushtay (কথা-চতুষ্টয়), Calcutta: Sahitya-Jantra, printed by Jagneshwar Ghosh, published by Kalidas Chakravarti, 1301 BS (1894); sole author Rabindranath Tagore. Validated (level 4) Wikisource scan pages with recorded page revisions; conversion rules as recorded for the Galpa-Dashak packets, plus the কথা-চতুষ্টয় opening page (collection name, story title and decorative scan ornaments dropped; the first section heading kept); every page-end hyphen rejoins a single word (none kept). Scan pages 49-85.
provenance.rights_note: রবীন্দ্রনাথ ঠাকুর died 1941; first published 1894. Term screen verdict for 2026: screen_pass. Wikisource transcription layer reused under CC BY-SA 4.0 with attribution; ShareAlike applies to the delivered transcription only.
